informative-css-background-image.why: Meaning carried by a CSS background image is exactly what 7.C evaluates.

meaningful-image-suppressed-as-decorativ.why: 7.B checks an empty-name/decorative image is not the only carrier of important info.

alt-not-an-alternative-filename-placehol.why: Non-empty name failing as an equivalent description is 7.A's name-quality judgment.

context-and-function-dependent-equivalen.why: 7.A requires the name to describe the image's meaning/purpose in context, not literal depiction.

complex-image-long-description-incomplet.why: 7.A judges whether the name/description gives an equivalent (complete) description of the image.

image-of-text-alt-omits-the-text.why: 7.A step 1.d requires an image of meaningful text to contain the same text.

text-lookalike-glyph-substitution.why: Homoglyph real text (no img/background/CAPTCHA element); F71 falls outside all four TT image tests.
